traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves one per node (two-ranked) in the order; Peperomia often opposite or whorled.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation gives two-ranked leaves (Piper, Aristolochia, Lactoris); Peperomia more varied. Both families with candidates already state 'spiral' (see conflicts), so this mainly fixes the order baseline.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): blades undivided, often heart-shaped with palmate veins.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): herbs, shrubs, vines and lianas with leafy stems; Asarum rhizomatous with few leaves per shoot, not a true rosette.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): Piper woody; Peperomia includes some annual herbs; Aristolochiaceae vines, lianas and rhizomatous herbs.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): Piper spikes terminal in origin but end up opposite a leaf as the shoot grows on; Aristolochioideae inflorescences axillary; Asaroideae flowers solitary terminal. Visual weighting ours.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): no hypanthium in Piperaceae; Aristolochiaceae ovary inferior with a perianth tube, not a hypanthium (Saruma partly adnate).

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Piperales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers perfect in most of the order; Old World Piper dioecious; Lactoris polygamo-dioecious.
